pictures.scene: Carlo Dolci, Saint Cecilia at the Organ - both hands down on the keys with the music open in front of her, sing to the LORD a new song
pictures.name: pd_dolci_lied

pictures.scene: Francois-Marius Granet, The Choir in the Capuchin Church on the Piazza Barberini, Rome - the whole community standing together in the choir stalls under the vault, His praise in the assembly of the godly
pictures.name: pd_granet_vergadering

pictures.scene: Giotto, Entry into Jerusalem - the children spreading their cloaks and breaking branches down from the tree before Him, let the children of Zion rejoice in their King
pictures.name: pd_giotto_koning

pictures.scene: Rosso Fiorentino, Angel Playing the Lute - the winged putto bent over the yellow lute with his hand on the strings, make music to Him with tambourine and harp
pictures.name: pd_rosso_snaren

pictures.scene: Titian, The Assumption of the Virgin - the apostles below with their arms flung up into the gold and the angels crowding the cloud, let the saints exult in glory
pictures.name: pd_titiaan_heerlijkheid

pictures.scene: Piero della Francesca, The Dream of Constantine - the angel coming down in light onto the sleeper on his bed inside the tent, let them shout for joy upon their beds
pictures.name: pd_piero_bedden

pictures.scene: Bartolome Bermejo, Saint Michael Triumphs over the Devil - the archangel in gold armour with the sword lifted over his head above the dragon, the high praises of God in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands
pictures.name: pd_bermejo_zwaard

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Expulsion of Heliodorus from the Temple - the two avengers coming down through the air with their rods raised and the horseman riding the robber down, to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples
pictures.name: pd_rafael_wraak

pictures.scene: Paolo Veronese, The Family of Darius before Alexander - the conquered royal house kneeling in the dust at the feet of the armoured victor, to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron
pictures.name: pd_veronese_ketenen

pictures.scene: Rogier van der Weyden, The Last Judgement - Saint Michael holding the balance steady between his two hands under the golden sphere, to execute the judgment written against them, this honor is for all His saints
pictures.name: pd_weyden_oordeel

pictures.scene: Pietro Perugino, The Ascension of Christ - Christ lifted into the rainbow mandorla with the angels playing harp and viol around Him and the apostles gazing up, Hallelujah
pictures.name: pd_perugino_halleluja

lines.text: Hallelujah!
Sing to the LORD a new song—
His praise in the assembly of the godly.
Let Israel rejoice in their Maker;
let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
Let them praise His name with dancing,
and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
For the LORD takes pleasure in His people;
He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
Let the saints exult in glory;
let them shout for joy upon their beds.
May the high praises of God be in their mouths,
and a double-edged sword in their hands,
to inflict vengeance on the nations
and punishment on the peoples,
to bind their kings with chains
and their nobles with shackles of iron,
to execute the judgment written against them.
This honor is for all His saints.
Hallelujah!
